hints.content: $\displaystyle \int_{3}^{3} f(x) \, dx$ is the net area between $f(x)$ and the $x$-axis from $x = 3$ to $x = 3$.
There is no area from $x = 3$ to $x = 3$ since the width of the interval is $0$.
